QuestInfo.name: Dangerous Slimes
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the slimes that are threatening the young boys and girls of the year 2021, and bring back #i4000545##t4000545#, #i4000546##t4000546#, and #i4000547##t4000547# to the Brainy Boy to prevent them from coming back. #b10#k of each should do it.\n
QuestInfo.2: You've purged the area of slimes, but more keep coming from somewhere. Maybe #p2082004# was on to something...
QuestInfo.0: Through the #t4001393#, you have found a future school full of slimes.

0.0: Don't come any closer! Who are you? Where is everyone? And where did all these monsters come from? \r\n#L0##bDon't worry. I'll help you.#l\n#k
0.1: Then defeat all of these monsters. I think they're exponentially increasing.

yes.0: The whole town is crawling with monsters, not just this place. Bring back items that look like #i4000545#, #i4000546#, and #i4000547# from them. #r10#k of each should do it. We might be able to run the monsters off with these.

no.0: You said you were going to help me! You lied!
